body:
## Pull request overview

Implements the remaining ListView types from `@objectstack/spec` by adding Kanban, Calendar, Gantt, and Map view components to `@object-ui/views`, along with exports, ComponentRegistry registration, tests, and README usage docs.

**Changes:**
- Added `ObjectKanban`, `ObjectCalendar`, `ObjectGantt`, and `ObjectMap` components and exported/registered them.
- Added Vitest/RTL test coverage for the new views.
- Updated `packages/views` README to document the new view components and data providers.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 19 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/views/src/index.tsx | Exports and registers the 4 new view components in `ComponentRegistry`. |
| packages/views/src/ObjectKanban.tsx | New kanban view implementation (currently rendered as a placeholder board UI). |
| packages/views/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx | New calendar view implementation (month grid UI with event mapping). |
| packages/views/src/ObjectGantt.tsx | New gantt view implementation (timeline + task list UI). |
| packages/views/src/ObjectMap.tsx | New map view implementation (placeholder visualization + marker list). |
| packages/views/src/__tests__/ObjectKanban.test.tsx | Tests for Kanban view behavior and rendering. |
| packages/views/src/__tests__/ObjectCalendar.test.tsx | Tests for Calendar view behavior and rendering. |
| packages/views/src/__tests__/ObjectGantt.test.tsx | Tests for Gantt view behavior and rendering. |
| packages/views/src/__tests__/ObjectMap.test.tsx | Tests for Map view behavior and rendering. |
| packages/views/README.md | Documents the new components and provider options. |
</details>

Several layout-critical values are applied via inline styles (minWidth/height/width/position). If this project is aiming for Tailwind-only styling, consider expressing these with Tailwind utilities (e.g., `h-[60px]`) and/or a CSS-variable + utility approach to avoid per-node inline styles, especially for progress widths.
```suggestion
                      <progress
                        className="block w-full h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden [&::-webkit-progress-bar]:bg-muted [&::-webkit-progress-value]:bg-primary [&::-moz-progress-bar]:bg-primary"
                        value={task.progress}
                        max={100}
                      />
```

This passes `schema.filter` directly as the backend `$filter`, but `schema.filter` is also where the map view config (`filter.map`) is stored. That mixes UI config with query filters and will likely break `dataSource.find` calls. Only forward actual filter expressions to `$filter`, and keep map config separate.

The `api` data provider path currently just logs a warning and returns an empty dataset. This contradicts the PR description/README claim that the views support `object/api/value` providers. Either implement the `api` provider here (similar to how other parts of the codebase fetch `data-table` data), or update the docs/PR description to reflect that `api` isn’t supported yet.

`extractCoordinates` uses `||` when reading `location.lat`/`location.lng` (and variants). This treats `0` as “missing”, so valid coordinates on the equator/prime meridian can be dropped or replaced. Use nullish checks (`??`) or explicit `typeof === 'number'` for each candidate field instead of `||`.
```suggestion
      const lat =
        typeof location.lat === 'number'
          ? location.lat
          : typeof location.latitude === 'number'
          ? location.latitude
          : undefined;
      const lng =
        typeof location.lng === 'number'
          ? location.lng
          : typeof location.lon === 'number'
          ? location.lon
          : typeof location.longitude === 'number'
          ? location.longitude
          : undefined;
```

The file header lists features like marker clustering and marker popups/tooltips, but the current implementation is explicitly a placeholder and does not implement those behaviors. Please update the doc comment to match what is actually supported (or implement the missing features).
```suggestion
 * A basic map-oriented visualization component that works with ObjectQL data sources.
 * Displays records as simple markers/pins derived from location data fields.
 * Implements the map view type from @objectstack/spec view.zod ListView schema.
 * 
 * Currently supported features:
 * - Derives latitude/longitude configuration from the view schema
 * - Location-based data visualization (records mapped to marker positions)
 * - Works with object/api/value data providers
 * - Optional callbacks for marker click/edit/delete provided by the parent
 * 
 * Limitations:
 * - Does NOT implement marker clustering
 * - Does NOT implement built-in marker popups/tooltips
 * 
 * Note: This is a minimal placeholder implementation. For production-ready maps
 * with clustering, popups, and rich interactions, integrate a proper mapping
 * library (e.g., Mapbox, Leaflet, Google Maps) in a higher-level component.
```

Inline styles are used for event coloring (`style={...borderLeft...}`), which makes theme/class overrides harder and diverges from Tailwind-first styling. Consider mapping `colorField` to a known set of Tailwind classes (or a CSS variable-based approach) instead of per-node inline styles.

The `api` provider branch is currently a no-op (warn + empty data). This conflicts with the README section claiming API provider support for all view components. Please either implement API fetching here or remove/qualify the API provider documentation.

The `api` provider branch currently only warns and returns empty results, which contradicts the PR description/README claim of `object/api/value` provider parity. Please implement API fetching or adjust the documentation/claims accordingly.

The README states that ObjectKanban has “drag-and-drop support” and that all views support an `api` provider. In this PR, Kanban is rendered as a static placeholder and the `api` provider branches in the view components are not implemented (warn + empty data). Please update the README to match current behavior or complete the missing implementations.

The “API Provider (Custom REST API)” section documents a `data.provider: 'api'` configuration, but the view components in this PR do not actually implement API fetching (they warn and render empty data). This section should either be implemented end-to-end or marked as not supported yet to avoid misleading users.

This component uses inline styles (`style={{ height: '600px' }}`), which makes styling harder to override and inconsistent with Tailwind-first styling used elsewhere in this package. Prefer Tailwind classes (e.g., `h-[600px]`) or a variant/prop-based height API.
```suggestion
      <div className="relative h-[600px] border rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
```

`handleCardMoveInternal` is never used, which means `onCardMove` is never triggered and the local update/persist logic is effectively dead code. Either wire this into actual drag-and-drop interactions, or remove the unused handler/prop to avoid suggesting functionality that isn’t present.

The component state `view`/`setView` is declared but never used, and the UI only renders a month grid. This does not match the stated “Month/week/day” support. Either implement view switching (and render week/day layouts) or remove the unused state and update the feature claims.

`dependenciesField` is parsed into `dependencies`, but dependencies are never rendered/used anywhere in the chart. Either implement dependency visualization (or at least expose the data via callbacks) or remove the unused config/feature claim to avoid misleading API surface.

The doc comment claims “Drag-and-drop kanban board”, but the current render path is a static placeholder with no drag-and-drop implementation. Please adjust the documentation (and README) or implement drag-and-drop so the feature claim matches reality.
